paretoFrontier.name: variant-B-partner-first
paretoFrontier.mechanism: Partner-first routing — when explicit partnerGuess is passed, scan families matching partner via id/tags/keywords/tier1; if score>=2 on allowed surface, wrap partner-aligned family in single-project workspace. Preserves multi-lane workspace + fallthrough on no partner.

paretoFrontier.name: variant-A-tier1-first
paretoFrontier.mechanism: Pre-workspace intercept scanning family tier1 keywords for >=2 token matches. Protocol-lane guard preserves multi-lane workspace.
paretoFrontier.retainedFor: architectural documentation — the mechanism works on live prompts but is mechanically bounded by 26 of 54 scenarios having initialPrompt:null. Escalated as Gen 8 trace-capture fix.
